name: Kingsford Manufacturing Company
old_description: Our charcoal has been proudly made in the USA since 1920. Available in a variety of flavors to give you a delicious, smoky taste for any occasion.
about:
Kingsford Manufacturing Company operates from Parsons, West Virginia, where it has produced charcoal since 1920. The business emphasizes that its charcoal has been proudly made in the United States since its founding year. No founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in the available information.

The company manufactures a range of charcoal briquets and wood pellets for grilling. Product lines include Original, Professional, Mesquite, Match Light instant-light briquets, and the Easy Light Bag single-use format. Pellets are marketed as a premium-flavor option for pellet grills. The homepage does not provide facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Kingsford’s products target consumer grilling occasions — tailgates, backyard barbecues, seafood cookouts, and everyday meals. The brand positions itself for home cooks and outdoor enthusiasts through retail channels, offering recipes and how-to guides alongside the fuel. No industrial or commercial customers are identified in the source material.

The company highlights its long-standing domestic production and flavor variety as differentiators. The Easy Light Bag is designed for fast, portable lighting, while the pellet line promises premium flavor without a premium price. Match Light briquets eliminate the need for lighter fluid. These claims constitute the stated value proposition.
